notes.title: Award-nominated puzzler reky gets Steam release date - 27th of May
notes.notes:
Developer [b]beyondthosehills [/b]and publisher [b]Plug In Digital[/b] today announced that [b]reky[/b], a game of elegantly designed logic challenges, will be released on Steam on [b]27th May[/b].

A logic puzzle game, [b]reky [/b]marries an elegance of design with an architectural minimalist aesthetic to create an experience that is fresh, stylish and satisfyingly challenging. The player interacts with the different puzzle elements of each level, shifting and moving them in order to create a path to the goal. Everything in the game is simple and functional, with only cubes, lines, exits, portals and a dash of colour used to create a large variety of brain-teasing challenges.

[b]reky [/b]is inspired by architectural and artistic styles like Bauhaus and technical drawing

[list]
    [*]Elegant logic puzzles, escalating to extreme challenge levels
    [*]Aesthetics inspired by architectural minimalism
    [*]Beautiful ambient soundtrack
    [*]96 levels to test yourself across
[/list]
